title: ccshelf plugin sidecar
description: Catalog-only metadata of one plugin, in catalog/plugins/<name>.toml (as the equivalent JSON object). In single-file mode (metadata_source = "marketplace") the same fields go in the marketplace entry's metadata object. Unknown keys are errors. Values are checked further by ccshelf lint.

owner.description: Team accountable for the plugin, as in CODEOWNERS: @user, @org/team or an email address.

when_to_use.description: Phrases for search and for choosing between plugins.

overlaps_with.description: Names of plugins a reader might confuse this one with; each must exist.

superseded_by.description: Replacement plugin; required when status is deprecated, must exist and must not be deprecated.

review_by.description: YYYY-MM-DD; a TOML local date is accepted. Required for active plugins.

support.description: Where to ask for help, for example #sre-help.

docs.description: Documentation link; http or https only.
